The cell secretaries should make it an ingrained revolutionary habit to study while working and vice versa and embody the voluntary and sincere attitude towards studying with which they always carry books in their hands.

The work of improving the qualifications and abilities of cell secretaries and strengthening Party cells urgently requires responsible and substantial guidance and assistance of Party organizations and officials at all levels.

Pointing to the shortcomings revealed in the course of making a critical analysis of the work of the Party organizations for implementing the policy of giving priority to the cells and strengthening them in recent years, Comrade Kim Jong Un emphasized the importance of the work for the Party officials to train the cell secretaries steadily with much care, and continued:

The provincial, city and county Party committees and primary Party committees should not be content with the implementation of the immediate policy-oriented tasks or production figures, but evaluate their work by considering how sincerely they have helped and given a boost to the cells in their work and how well the Party cells play their role.

It is important to direct efforts to building up the ranks of cell secretaries with those who have a high degree of Party spirit and great practical ability and who enjoy the confidence of the masses and, at the same time, to intensify the work of improving their practical qualifications in various forms and by various methods so as to help all Party cell secretaries possess the capability to design and carry out their work independently and creatively.
In fact, it takes a great deal of effort to train a good Party cell secretary.

Bearing in mind that just as there is no born revolutionary, there is no fully prepared Party cell secretary, senior Party officials should sincerely help and lead every cell secretary so as to train them to be reliable primary political workers of our Party.

In keeping with the constant change in the ranks of cell secretaries, Party organizations should give officials clear and distinct assignments concerning Party cells and provide detailed guidance and assistance so that they can be exemplary in all aspects, ranging from the basic matters of the cell work to appearance, words and deeds.

Comrade Kim Jong Un particularly stressed the need for the officials to give positive encouragement to the cell secretaries so that they can exert themselves in their work with a high sense of honour and pride. He said:

Through the current conference, Party cell secretaries should look back upon their work with an open mind, share excellent successes and experience, draw lessons from shortcomings and fully arm themselves with our Party’s ideas, will, lines and policies once again.

By doing so, after the conference, they can make their cells the perfect crystallization of patriotism and loyalty and a living organism that throbs and works with the Party’s breath and pulse, so as to effect an upsurge in strengthening the Party cells and thus ensure the successful completion of the struggle in the ninth term of the Party Central Committee.
Comrade cell secretaries,
If you record your career as Party cell secretaries in your autobiographies, it would take less than one or two lines.

It should be the view of life of Party cell secretaries to find their greatest happiness and worth of life in seeing the members of their cells being respected as innovators, meritorious persons and heroes, although they may mount the platform of honour less than others and always stand behind others, while giving credit for success to others.

Only those Party cell secretaries who feel their shoulders burdened with a heavy responsibility as they look back on the day’s work and reflect on whether they made any mistake, while reviewing their work every day, can reach the level intended by the Party.

When the Party cell secretaries keep improving their work level and ability and play a proactive role, our Party with hundreds of thousands of cells will have inexhaustible viability and vitality, and this will surely lead to the proud successes of comprehensive development of the state.

I firmly believe that all the participants in the conference and all the other cell secretaries of the Party will make a more responsible and positive contribution to the historic struggle for Party and state building in the new era by becoming the initial sparks in strengthening the Party and the vanguard in implementing its policies, bearing deep in mind our Party's idea of giving priority to its cell and the role of its members. -0-

eb3e26744949129ab39f514e18616423.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Nuclear Materials Production and Nuclear Weapons Research Field
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 26 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave on-site guidance to the nuclear materials production and nuclear weapons research field on November 25.

The working visit made by the head of state, which is of important significance to the enrichment of the nuclear arsenal of the country, is clearly aimed to consolidate the nuclear posture of the country in every way by further accelerating the exponential updating of the self-defensive nuclear capabilities, the honour and absolute power of our state, both in quality and quantity.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the Munitions Industry Department of the WPK Central Committee and the DPRK Nuclear Weapons Institute.

Comrade Kim Jong Un toured the weapons-grade nuclear materials production base, the nuclear-powered equipment production base and the nuclear weapons institute and reviewed the activities of the nuclear materials and nuclear weapons production field in 2026 for implementing the nuclear strategic plan set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
First, he learned in detail about a newly-built important materials production factory.
The factory is putting powerful spurs to the efficient production after technically upgrading many of its equipment.

Comrade Kim Jong Un acquainted himself with the construction of the infrastructure of another factory under expansion project and highly praised the relevant scientists, technicians and officials for their devoted and responsible efforts, a reflection of the extraordinary spirit of fortitude, loyalty and patriotism.

Saying that the important tasks of systematically increasing the nuclear materials production capacity to meet the long-term demand for reinforcing the nuclear forces and putting it on a highly-developed technical basis are being carried out scrupulously and successfully, he noted that the Party Central Committee appreciates that it is a very positive trend.
He familiarized himself with the performance of the newly-produced nuclear-powered equipment and devices.

The development and production of such equipment and devices are of great significance in steadily improving the efficiency of the nuclear forces' deterrent and enhancing its adaptation to an actual war, he said.

Noting that his current inspection of the weapons-grade nuclear materials production base is part of the efforts to strengthen the defence capacity, a sovereign right to reliably defend the state's security environment in response to the variable nuclear threats approaching the Korean peninsula moment by moment against the background of the serious geopolitical changes in the recent international nuclear security structure, he stressed that today's world most evidently highlights the necessity and inevitability of those efforts.

Referring to the recent intolerable moves of the enemy states which are highly developing the nuclear capabilities and ceaselessly renewing their nuclear posture, he noted that our military leadership is taking a serious note of the fact that the U.S. has incited its vassal states in the vicinity of our country to the possession of nuclear-powered submarines by introducing the dangerous precedent of nuclear proliferation through AUKUS to Northeast Asia and established a nuclear military alliance system throughout the world including the Asia-Pacific region by attempting to share and use nukes with its allies.

The reality, in which the international nuclear non-proliferation system has collapsed as a matter of fact and the danger of using nukes is increasing day by day due to the enemies' moves to gradually facilitate the nuclear technology transfer and access to nuclear weapons within the so-called alliance, is posing a grave threat to the security structure in the Korean peninsula, demanding a new defence logic, vigilance and manifestation in the concept of national defence.

The concept of strengthening our nuclear deterrence came to have a new meaning, essentially different from that in the past, owing to the political and military situation prevailing around our state, and all the geopolitical crises remind us once again that national security is the most important affair which cannot rely on the international law or other countries.

Comrade Kim Jong Un affirmed that our state decidedly accessed to nuclear weapons and perpetuated its possession of them due to the nuclear threat and pressure of the most vicious outside forces and that the validity and substantiality of our possession of nuclear weapons and the trend of bolstering up its nuclear capability in quality and quantity are an irreversible reality.

Saying that the DPRK's bolstering of nuclear forces is a legitimate and righteous defensive measure fully in line with the sovereign state's right to self-defence, he most clearly reconfirmed our state's steadfast will to possess nuclear weapons which can never be changed by anything.
On the same day, he visited the Nuclear Weapons Institute to hear a general report on its activities in 2026 and review them.
Comrade Kim Jong Un noted that the recent updated records in the nuclear weapons manufacturing field are a great encouraging success to the future implementation of the state nuclear forces policy.

Learning about the mission and technical specifications of technically updated warheads of different common standards, he said that the proud production results in 2026, a year of key importance in bolstering up the state nuclear forces in quality and quantity, are a fruition of our nuclear scientists' outstanding brains and strenuous and extraordinary efforts. And he expressed his heartfelt thanks to the nuclear weapons technical research group which is developing the nuclear capability in a sustained and steady way while laying a development track of original and unique nuclear technology.

Noting that the technological transformation made by our nuclear science research group is now manifested as a result of putting the nuclear weapons on a highly-developed basis in quality and quantity, he stressed that the nuclear weapons manufacturing sector should pay attention to utilizing the tactical nukes of different missions in multiple domains and this is an important and urgent task raised from a tactical nukes' military value in modern warfare and from the inevitable reality facing the border with the most dangerous enemy state.

Noting that the status of ours as a nuclear weapons state that was perpetuated by the Constitution, the supreme law of the state, is absolutely inviolable, Comrade Kim Jong Un declared at home and abroad once again the details of why our nuclear policy was enshrined in law, the historic validity of having done so and the firm stand of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to steadfastly defend and exercise in a responsible way its legitimate obligations and right.

"Today it is the same case with other regions of the world, but in particular the reckless nuclear arms build-up and expansion of the nuclear military alliance the enemy states are committing rapidly in the region of the Korean peninsula are posing a real threat to the DPRK’s security right.
This is a current and long-term, prospective threat we should cope with in a thoroughgoing way.

Our nuclear policy is an outcome of a righteous decision adopted with these unavoidable circumstances as a prerequisite and background, as well as a core item for guaranteeing the sovereignty of the Republic enshrined in the supreme law of the state according to the common opinion and with the wholehearted support of the Party, government and people.
No one has the right to force us to go against our Constitution or the right to attempt to amend it.
Our nuclear capability has now become a reality.
Denying this reality is just the recognition of failure.

The status of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state will never change simply at the rhetoric insistence of the outside forces, and in disregard of the ‘denuclearization’ argument by the forces that cannot read the changed state of affairs keeping no notice of the objective reality, the present status of our state will remain in the historical record testifying to their failure.
The stark entity of the outside enemy armed with nuclear weapons and our confrontational, self-defensive nukes are in inseparable relations from A to Z.

Strengthening our capability for defending the national sovereignty, interests and people cannot constitute a provocation, and abusing it as a provocation by the enemy states is a real provocation and a major threat that should be countered and eliminated at any cost.

Whoever attempts to deny or plunder the constitutional status of our state, it will be the most serious infringement on our national sovereignty and interference in our internal affairs aimed at forcing us to give up our Constitution and social system, and we will regard this as an open declaration of war and him as our enemy.

It is certain they will have to admit that the surest way to maintain the balance of forces and guarantee peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region is to respect the Constitution of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and we have the courage to exercise infinite patience in making such fact an established theory.

Our state and people are steadfast in their stand not to pawn or cede their sovereignty and security interests in return for the deceptive preaching and good will of enemy countries, whoever says what and whatever the circumstances.

It is enough for us to have the strength to contain and control the nuclear threats by the enemies and to retaliate in a worst-case scenario, and we will never seek the recognition and approval of anyone.

We will never abuse our right as a responsible nuclear weapons state, but completely prevent anyone from abusing international law to encroach on the domains under our sovereignty through a super-powerful and resolute counteraction.

As long as there exist the evil forces adopting nuclear weapons as a means of seizing hegemony, our possession of nuclear weapons is our irreversible option and will remain forever in the future, too, as it is at present as a core component for the existence and sovereignty of our state and the supreme guarantee for defending the national sovereignty."

We are now going through the most responsible and important historic process in guaranteeing the medium- and long-term security of our state, he said, adding that the nuclear forces of the DPRK will carry out its mission of war deterrence in any case and that he firmly believes that they will play an important role of preventing war in the most acute region to greatly contribute to maintaining peace and security in the region and the rest of the world.

Stressing that our nuclear policy and all the efforts to bolster up the nuclear forces are based on the international situation manifesting that the constant nuclear threat of the enemy countries cannot be spontaneously ceased, he expressed expectation and belief that the nuclear forces of the DPRK and its nuclear weapons development and production field would fulfill their responsible mission, unconditionally faithful to our constitution which perpetuates its possession of nukes.

Comrade Kim Jong Un's on-site guidance to the nuclear field serves as an important historic occasion of providing new stability to peace and security in the region and the rest of the world by clearly indicating the righteous and legitimate course of our state's possession of nuclear weapons and the defensive nature of the DPRK's nuclear posture and the direction of its development and evolution in correlation with the ever-changing international military and political structure and global strategic stability. -0-

56099cee91ff95e75b43658b5df98931.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with the participants in the Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK on November 26.
He was greeted by Jo Yong Won and Ju Chang Il, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee.

All the participants paid the highest tribute to the benevolent father, looking up with deep emotion to him who puts forward them as the vanguard fighters, hard-core elements for accomplishing the cause of our Party.

Comrade Kim Jong Un gave encouragement to the participants who are imbued with our Party's idea of giving priority to Party cells and the role of Party members at the Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of the WPK and going to make a fresh start of the sacred journey for the strengthening of our Party and the prosperity of the Republic with extraordinary determination and soaring enthusiasm.

He noted that the steadfast fighting spirit of the Party cell secretaries, with which they have regarded the ennobling appellation Party cell secretary as their highest pride though it is not their honour or occupation, powerfully inspired the masses to the implementation of the Party policies with the noble sense of self-consciousness and great enthusiasm and put their shoulders into any hard and difficult undertakings to make a breakthrough on the road of advance, and the unsparing efforts they made for the harmony and sound development of the collective are associated with the remarkable successes achieved, hastening the days, and deepen the people's trust in our Party and our social system and their confidence in their own might and cause.

Saying that today's reality, in which our cause is going through an era of transformation that no one has ever witnessed and expanding and deepening on an unprecedented scale, requires the Party cells to further enhance their fighting efficiency, he stressed that the strength of the great unity of all the people wholeheartedly rallied close around the Party and the irresistible might for loyalty and patriotism are guaranteed by vigorous activities of the Party cells stretching across the country just like blood vessels and responsible role of the Party cell secretaries that no one can perform in their place.

He affirmed that our Party would resolutely make bigger strides and win successes, relying on millions of Party members infinitely loyal to the Party and the revolutionary cause and the cell secretaries, scouts for implementing the Party's policies, not on any chances or objective conditions although new long-term goals and tasks are enormous ones going beyond precedents and limitation.

He expressed expectation and belief that the cell secretaries in charge of the basic bastions, direct combat units for strengthening the whole Party and implementing the Party's decisions, would always be mindful of the requirements of the Party and the times that they should become a hi-fi amplifier to correctly convey the Party's idea and intention to the Party members and other masses and a clean mirror reflecting the image of the Party, and make a positive contribution to consolidating in every way the fighting efficiency of our Party with pure conscience of Party membership, the trait of devotedly setting personal examples, mature qualifications and fervent human love.

All the participants shouted slogans reflecting their loyalty and firm resolve to usher in a period of a new leap forward in the Party cell work by regarding the idea and leadership of the great Party Central Committee as their lifeblood and becoming the initial sparks in strengthening the Party and the vanguard in implementing its policies in order to reliably guarantee the successful implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Party. -0-

e4897efd5d0fb068527247a7b7e9c783.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Enjoys Performance Given by Visiting Russian Artistes
paragraphs: Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed a performance given by Russian artistes at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre to mark the 13th meeting of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology on November 26.
Among the audience were leading officials of the Party and the government, officials concerned and officials, creators, artistes and teachers of different art troupes and art education institutions.
The government delegation of the Russian Federation, the delegation of the Russian Ministry of Culture and staff members of the Russian embassy in Pyongyang appreciated the performance.

Prior to the performance, Comrade Kim Jong Un met Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is head of the government delegation of the Russian Federation, Andrei Maluishev, vice-minister of Culture who is head of the delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation, and Andrey Podelyshev, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and welcomed the Russian delegations' visit to Pyongyang.
When he appeared in the auditorium together with the Russian envoys, the audience greeted them with loud applause.
The co-chairmen of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology made speeches.

The speakers noted that the performance would serve as a significant occasion of deepening the traditional friendly relations between the peoples of the two countries and injecting vitality in the efforts to boost the exchange and cooperation in various fields.
Famous singers including People's Artiste of Russia Larisa Dolina and artistes of the state academy national orchestra named after N. P. Osipov took part in the performance.

Put on the stage overflowing with the feelings of friendship and amicability were numbers impressively portraying the nationality and ardent patriotism of the Russian people and their indomitable spirit and optimistic life.
The singers admirably sang DPRK songs to the tune of beautiful and elegant music, deeply impressing the audience.
The performance of Russian artistes was highly acclaimed by the audience for their rich artistic skills, refined depiction and high-level rendition.
At the end of the performance, flower baskets were handed over to the performers.
Comrade Kim Jong Un mounted the stage to congratulate them on their successful performance and had a photo taken with them.
After the performance, he had a talk with Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is head of the government delegation of the Russian Federation.
He appreciated that the cooperation between the two countries is developing more closely and expanding in various fields.
He asked to convey his warmest greetings and best wishes to President Vladimir Putin of the Russian Federation. -0-
